summary: Punch and shake juice for any Transform, built on the tween engine.
overview: Static helpers for the short feedback that makes an interaction feel solid — a scale punch on a button press, a shake on an invalid action. For cameras specifically, CameraShake remains the better choice: it accumulates trauma across overlapping hits rather than replaying a fixed punch.
useCases: A button that pops when pressed.
An inventory slot that shakes on an invalid drop.
A world object reacting to a hit without an animation.

gotchas.title: It animates the transform, so it fights a layout system
gotchas.body: Punching a UI element under a Layout Group means the group keeps overwriting the position. Punch a child, or disable the layout while it plays.
